ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly high-intensity white base. Significant low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated at the central fluke join. Left lobe displays a prominent, thick, curvilinear black streak in the upper region. Right lobe features a dispersed pattern of thin linear streaks and small circular black splotches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 105 degrees and moderate pixel-depth relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary across both lobes. The left distal tip displays a cluster of high-amplitude, high-contrast texture (barnacles). The right lobe edge exhibits a higher frequency of low-amplitude, sawtooth-like variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outer edges tapering to sharp lateral tips, following a symmetric outward-curving trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the lower-right lobe, corresponding to old attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive series of dark, diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) localized primarily on the right lobe, with several distinct unaligned scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized high-contrast, high-relief cluster of calcified growth (barnacles) at the extreme lateral tip of the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique, thick, hooked black pigmentation mark in the upper-central region of the left lobe, distinct from the finer rake marks.
